title: Introducing Binance Wallet DeFi: 40+ Protocols, 1,000+ Pools, and Native Position Management
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Wallet is launching DeFi, a new experience built for on-chain users. Previously known as Wallet (Web3) Earn, it has been redesigned and expanded to reflect the full range of DeFi activity, which now supports three core DeFi product categories in one place: DeFi Earn:  Discover on-chain yield opportunities across supported protocols; DeFi Loans:  Access borrowing solutions directly within Binance Wallet; Liquidity Pools:  Add, manage, and remove liquidity positions without leaving the App. With 40+ protocols and 1,000+ pools across BNB Smart Chain (BSC), Ethereum, Base, and Arbitrum, this upgrade marks Binance Wallet evolving into a more comprehensive DeFi gateway, helping users access and manage more on-chain strategies in one place. To celebrate the launch, Binance Wallet will introduce a series of campaigns with  $2,000,000 in rewards . Learn More What’s New in Binance Wallet DeFi 1. Broader Protocol, Pools, and Chain Coverage Binance Wallet DeFi now supports 40+ protocols and 1,000+ pools across BNB Smart Chain, Ethereum, Base, and Arbitrum, giving users broader access to on-chain yield opportunities directly within the App. 2. Unified DeFi Position Management Users can now view staking, liquidity pool, and loan positions in the DeFi tab under the Asset page , with faster real-time updates powered by proprietary data parsing. By consolidating positions across supported protocols, Binance Wallet DeFi makes it significantly easier to monitor exposure, track performance, and manage exits on BNB Smart Chain, Ethereum, Base, and Arbitrum without switching across multiple third-party dApps or losing track of where your assets are deployed. 3. Full Liquidity Pool Support Binance Wallet now supports full liquidity pool lifecycle actions, allowing users to add liquidity, remove liquidity, and claim accumulated fees directly within the DeFi page. Liquidity positions can also be accessed from the Asset-DeFi tab, helping users more easily manage positions opened across different protocols. Note: Supported protocols include Uniswap v3, Uniswap v4, PancakeSwap v3, and PancakeSwap Infinity, covering BNB Smart Chain, ETH, Arbitrum, and Base (chain availability varies by protocol and version). 4. Native Loan Access Users can borrow directly through Venus and upcoming Lista protocols on BNB Smart Chain with competitive rates, expanding Binance Wallet DeFi into broader capital efficiency use cases. 5. Enhanced User Experience for Seamless Access The DeFi interface has been revamped across the homepage, token and protocol lists, investment detail pages, and asset-level DeFi views. New entry points make it easier for users to discover opportunities from idle token balances and access DeFi actions in fewer steps. More protocol information (e.g., team background, related news) is also available in-app, helping users better evaluate and understand the protocols they interact with. Upcoming DeFi Season Campaign Following the DeFi revamp, Binance Wallet will launch a DeFi Season with a total of $2,000,000 in rewards across staking, loans, and liquidity pools, featuring projects including Spark, Sky, Lorenzo, Lista, Venus, Uniswap and PancakeSwap.  Beginning 2026-05-28, these campaigns will roll out on a weekly basis across three dedicated themes, kicking off with DeFi Earn, followed by DeFi Loans in Week 2, and Liquidity Pools in Week 3. Please see the  campaign page  for more details and stay tuned to the Binance Wallet official channels.
